thread:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT -> dedicated pool node degraded for tenant neptuneai (VPC). Node: gpu-node-77. Symptom: repeated ECC corrected errors + kernel OOM on GPU0. Affected capacity: neptuneai-dpool (2x reserved nodes). Please ACK and triage.
Priya S: acked. I'm oncall. pulling logs now. 
Sam R: I'm here, will take infra lead. Priya can you paste dmesg + nvidia-smi? 
Priya S: logs pasted, short snippets below. looks like PCIe link flaps then driver reset.
Priya S: ```[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 79, PCIe link down
[ 12345.679012] GPU0: Ecc corrected errors rising
[ 12345.881234] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 1234 (model-serving)```
Akram S: on call for node-level hardware. Can remote into host for power check. pinging DC ops.
eng-infra-bot: Observability: node gpu-node-77 CPU 95% for last 10m, GPU memory pressure high, instance uptime 42d.
Jia C: from runtime side, we see increased 503s for neptuneai model endpoint, retry & fallback triggered for ~12% of requests in last 3m. 
Marta V: CS notified neptuneai primary contacts. They report elevated latency and some failed calls in dashboard. They are asking for ETA. 
Priya S: mitigation plan: cordon+drain node, taint to prevent scheduling, shift traffic to spare nodes in pool, enable fallback quantized variant for tenant. executing now.
Sam R: agree. we'll cordon then drain with grace 30s to avoid long queues. if pods don't evacuate we'll force-delete. also want PCIe reset attempt before full hardware swap.
Priya S: running: ```kubectl cordon gpu-node-77 && kubectl drain gpu-node-77 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30```
deploy-bot: Drain initiated for gpu-node-77: 14 pods to evict. progress: 4/14 evicted.
Priya S: evictions proceeding. starting driver soft-reset: `/opt/nvidia/bin/nvidia-smi --gpu-reset -i 0`
Akram S: PCIe link not stable; driver reset failed on GPU0. DC ops on-site escalating to hardware replace. recommending isolate node.
Sam R: tainting node to NoSchedule to be safe: `kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-77 dedicated=isolated:NoSchedule`
eng-infra-bot: Workload routing update: requests for neptuneai will move to neptuneai-dpool-spare-01/02 and to hosted-burst fallback if needed. Traffic shift at 21:12 UTC.
Jia C: enabling model variant switch for neptuneai: enabling `gptx-lite-8q` for non-critical routes to reduce mem. policy applied via config override. 
Jia C: config snippet: `routes.neptuneai.*.model_fallback: [gptx-lite-8q, gptx-base-8]`
Marta V: emailed customer with short incident notice and temporary mitigation. told them ETA 3h for hardware swap, offered temporary credits. they asked for persisted KV cache handling — confirming no cache loss expected for in-flight requests.
Leo M: AE on call - pushing for expedited hardware swap and test window. cc: account exec. Neptunai expects full update every 30m.
Sam R: handoff: Priya -> Sam for hardware/replace ops. Priya will continue until Sam confirms node isolated. Priya, please add pager duty note.
Priya S: handing off now. I'm switching to monitoring only, will stand by for customer comms. 
Sam R: takeover ack. I've opened hardware ticket HT-87321 with DC ops and asked for node replacement + GPU swap. ETA on-site 1.5h.
Akram S: prepping spare host template and NVMe image; if swap takes long we can reprovision new node from dedicated spare pool and reattach to dpool. planning warm image to shorten boot time.
Jia C: runtime impact: KV cache warmup might cause small latency spike when new node takes load. recommend pre-warming with synthetic traffic for neptuneai. I'll run a small replay.
Sam R: running synthetic warm-up now against new node candidate neptuneai-spare-01. progress logged.
eng-infra-bot: Traffic shift complete: 98% of steady-state requests now routed off gpu-node-77. error rate for neptuneai back down to +2% above baseline.
Marta V: customer updated at 21:35 UTC. they confirmed reduced errors but still seeing occasional 500s for long-tail requests. offered escalation path.
Sam R: next steps: 1) confirm hardware replacement complete and burn-in tests, 2) reprovision if needed, 3) postmortem + RCA. assigning owners Sam + Akram. timeline: replacement + validation within 3h, postmortem in 72h.
Priya S: closing oncall baton. Priya out, Sam now primary. :white_check_mark: 
Sam R: I'll file incident ticket INC-2176001234 and link logs. tagging eng-runtime, eng-infra, cs.
Marta V: CS ticket CS-98321 created for customer compensation and follow-ups.
incident-bot: Incident status: P1 -> Mitigated (traffic shifted, node isolated). Monitoring for 2h.
Sam R: thanks everyone. please add any reproduction steps or odd logs to the incident ticket. Postmortem owners: Sam R, Akram S, Jia C.
Marta V: I'll follow up with the customer after the hardware swap validation to confirm SLA impact and finalize credits.
Priya S: one last note: confirm we didn't accidentally evict any admin-side stateful pods — double-checking.
eng-infra-bot: Audit: no admin stateful pods evicted. All evicted pods were stateless serving pods; persistent storage volumes remained attached.
Sam R: excellent. I'll update INC and schedule follow-up.
